tools.name: what_can_you_do
tools.description: FREE — what ListPlus can do for you: every action, the fields we can fill with their price per record, the free limits, and (with a key) your balance and day budget. Call this first if unsure.

tools.name: find_person
tools.description: FREE (rate-limited) — find a person: name, job title, company, location, LinkedIn profile, how sure. Give first_name + last_name + company (or domain), a LinkedIn URL, a work e-mail, or a question in `query` ("CFO of Tink in Berlin"). No e-mail or phone in the answer — those are enrich_records.
